propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 silently corrupts Markdown content during commonmark-to-jira conversion by escaping code-span punctuation, deleting HTML comments, and rewriting --> delimiters
A two-phase lexer must lock protected blocks (fences, HTML comments, four-space code, backtick spans) before classification to prevent post-render preservation loss
Inline Jira markers (unambiguous: {{…}}, [a|b], {color:}; ambiguous: *x*, _x_) must be split so re-rendering already-wiki text does not create 2-cycle instability
A deterministic fixed-seed corpus of 178 bodies (29 code-arrow / 29 table / 120 prose) must measure coverage at >=0.90 body ratio and >=0.95 character ratio with non-vacuous changed units
Every code fragment from source must appear byte-identically in the rendered output or that unit falls back to identity, without logging the body
The renderer is unwired pure state; WikiTextCodec, live sends, and cutover logic remain unchanged per story 3388
